The branch that walks past a CTE's identifier list to find the actual DML keyword (SELECT, INSERT, etc.) had an inverted condition: it used `elif token.ttype != T.Keyword.CTE:` instead of `==`, which meant this lookahead only ran when the first token was *not* a WITH keyword — i.e., exactly backwards.
